dedupe_keys.name: dns user activity fingerprints from metropolitan isp traffic 2023 2024

description: This collection summarises DNS activity observed in a metropolitan Internet service provider network during December 2023–February 2024. Czech Technical University in Prague and University of South Bohemia researchers derive records from 2.3 billion DNS queries covering 6.2 million distinct domain names. Each record has 1,137 classification attributes describing daily activity and hourly patterns, including content-category aggregates. Zenodo provides a ZIP archive free under CC BY 4.0; its inspected metadata do not identify the enclosed table format. Coverage is one provider and three months, with no claim of representative national behaviour. Aggregated features and selected categorisation rules are limitations for transferring demand profiles. A reviewer-assessed use is testing daily user-activity patterns in agent-based network-demand simulations. platform-ns-3 is a related communications simulator, without verified feature conversion. No user-level records were downloaded, linked to people or used for identification.
name: DNS user-activity fingerprints from metropolitan ISP traffic, 2023–2024
notes: G2-0269. Metadata only. Proposed simulation uses are reviewer assessments. No dataset, model or article PDF downloaded; no program executed.
